summary: 72-year-old male Boulder resident died after a collision between his skis and a snowboarder on the Windmill run at Eldora Mountain Resort ~11 a.m.; ski patrol CPR, pronounced dead at the scene at 11:43 a.m.; the snowboarder (Wellington resident) was treated for collision injuries, interviewed by deputies, no charges filed (BCSO 21-5768)
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Eldora ski patrol; North Colorado MedEvac (air standby)
notes: Follow-up coverage identified the skier as Ron LeMaster, 72 (parent-opened SnowBrains identification article; the Mountain-Ear article withholds the name pending next-of-kin notification).
